items.item_text: Bachelors degree or combination of education and/or additional job related experience in lieu of the degree

Three to five (3-5) years progressive experience and /or training in physician/provider relations, physician recruiting and broad healthcare business operations to include customer service and ongoing improvement techniques, or the equivalent combination of education and experience
Must have strong communication and collaboration experience and enjoy team based work
Demonstrated leadership, program or project management related experience preferred
Previous administrative support experience a plus

Manages collaboratively and coaches others to achieve optimal performance; delegates effectively; praises/rewards contributions; defines clear roles and responsibilities; sets goals and leads initiatives; adjusts plans as necessary.

Work with Physician Recruiter for a seamless hand-off of newly hired clinicians. Develop and maintain an on-boarding, off-boarding and retention process that is optimum for clinicians, medical group and foundation. Act as an integral participant of the Transition Team meeting, working with the team facilitator to ensure all activities related to new and departing providers are assigned and actively managed to completion by established deadlines. Assists with actions/initiatives designed to build rapport and support long-term satisfaction, integration and retention.

Sharing authority and responsibility with others to move decision making and accountability downward through the organization enabling individuals to stretch their capabilities and accomplish the business unit’s strategic priorities.
Keeping the organization’s mission, vision and values at the forefront of associate decision making and action.
Interacting with others in a way that gives them confidence in one’s intentions and those of the organization.

Understanding of how to anticipate, recognize, and deal effectively with existing or potential conflicts at the individual, group, or situation level; ability to apply this understanding appropriately to diverse situations.
Excellent written communication, attention to detail; excellent verbal communication and relationship building skills
Ideal candidate will have strong assessment, critical thinking skills, process improvement and problem solving skills
